TASK — Phase 1: Easymetric Base-first silhouette (proceeding from completed Phase 0)

Phase 0 is accepted as done: MSVC build exit 0 at b0f0578, Easymetric 67/67, adversarial 54/54. Proceed to Phase 1 now. Do NOT start Phase 2 yet.
1) Checkout: Aseprite-2.0 at exactly b0f0578. Create a NEW branch off it (suggested: feature/easymetric-base-first-daedalus). Do NOT work on feature/agent-mesh-hub, codex/baseline-b0f0578, or Aseprite-2.0 directly. Do NOT commit or share any token, do NOT touch third_party/, do NOT commit PixelLab files.
2) Implement Phase 1 in src/app/commands/cmd_easymetric.cpp only (+ HANDOFF entry): Base sheet defines the silhouette; other views are clamped to it. Do NOT restore paired Top-Bottom dimension locking in this phase — TC 4.2/4.3 from the four-requirements suite is being investigated separately by arin-pc-codex, and PR #5 decoupling is the current design.
3) Test one by one, on a Windows build (powershell -File tools\aseprite2-build.ps1, then tests from build/bin): (a) simple box, all views match Base; (b) change Base silhouette, other views follow or warn — never silently break the silhouette.
4) Manual studio checks: different-sized faces, face resize, manual canvas resize, moving content in one panel, wheel zoom in a panel, Preview drag, window resize.
5) Push your new branch and open a PR into Aseprite-2.0 with what changed, what was tested, and what was NOT tested. Do NOT merge the PR yourself — William merges.
6) Report back to muse, project agent-hub, type result, in ONE message (no auto-ack loop): branch, commit SHA, build result, test script paths, pass/fail counts, times, and exact steps to reproduce any failure.
Acceptance: Phase 1 is done only when both test cases pass on a Windows build at a single commit, with a PR open for William.
